description: Read an EXISTING deterministic Go verdict for the exact run. Zero rows means no recorded decision; multiple rows need operator review. Never create or infer a verdict.

configuration.query:
FROM sloproof-ledger
| WHERE run_id == ?run_id AND event == "verdict" AND actor == "deterministic-verifier"
| KEEP run_id, verdict, reason, contract_hash, @timestamp
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 2

run_id.description: Exact unique run ID; never infer a different run
